subcategory_text: Categories of individuals (e.g., customers, employees or prospective employees, consumers) whose data are being processed are inventoried.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-8 (Critical Infrastructure System Inventory); NIST SP 800-122 (Guide to Protecting the Confidentiality of PII)
GDPR Art. 9 (Special categories of personal data), Art. 10 (criminal convictions)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-06 (data categories inventoried)
implementation_examples: Maintain a current list of the categories of individuals (e.g., customers, employees, prospective employees, consumers, patients) whose data is processed across the estate
Tag each category with the corresponding sensitivity class (standard, special category, criminal) and the lawful basis relied on
Use the categories list when conducting privacy-risk assessment to scope impact to the relevant data subjects
assessment_objectives: Determine whether a complete list of categories of data subjects is maintained
Determine whether sensitivity classes and lawful bases are recorded per category
Determine whether the categories list is used as input to privacy-risk assessment
Determine whether the categories list is reviewed for completeness on a defined cadence
